Name: More Wilford Gift Likes
Author: bikinavisho
Description:
This mod adds some items from various Json Assets mods as "Loved" gifts to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]New NPC Wilford[/url]. I used the base set of "Loved" gifts from the mod description of Pumpkin Pie, Poppies, and Peaches as the core for this expansion of his "Loved" gifts. 

[b][size=3]New Loved Gifts: [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Cream Cheese Filled Pumpkin Muffin ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1897]Sweet Tooth[/url]﻿)
[*]Pumpkin Cake ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1897]Sweet Tooth[/url]﻿)
[*]Peach Cobbler ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1897]Sweet Tooth[/url]﻿)
[*]Peach Sherbet ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1897]Sweet Tooth[/url]﻿)
[*]Pumpkin Spice Scone ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]PPJA - Artisan Valley[/url]﻿)
[*]Pumpkin Spice Latte ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]PPJA - Artisan Valley[/url]﻿)
[*]Poppy Fragrance Oil ([url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10296212]KAYA's Perfumed Oil[/url]﻿)
[*]Delicious Peach Cake ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12244]Cakes & Creams[/url]﻿)
[*]Baker's Pumpkin Bundt Cake (Baker's Life)
[*]Better Pumpkin Pie ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1742]PPJA Even More Recipes[/url]﻿)
[*]Peach Tea ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2607]Tea Time[/url]﻿)
[*]Pumpkin Pie Frozen Yogurt ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12308]Frozen Yogurt[/url]﻿)
[*]Peach Frozen Yogurt ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12308]Frozen Yogurt[/url]﻿)
[*]Peach Sliders ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3468]Bonster's Recipes[/url]﻿)
[*]Pumpkin Rolls ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3468]Bonster's Recipes[/url]﻿)
[/list]
Note: [b]you do not need all of the mods listed here to use this mod. This mod will work even if you only have one of these mods. 


[size=4]Install Instructions[/size][/b]
- Download mod 
- Unzip mod in mods folder
- Run game!
